## Failing line (new blocker)

**B-1 — X07 survives: the `tombstone` op of the admission is not pinned, and dropping it brings back N-49 on the
honest stage-end path.**

* *The promise.* The ruling's required change says to "admit coarser ITEM_FACE tombstone/delete writes whose slot is no
  longer live". C-0235 (b) states the same. The batch.ts doc comment says "a tombstone or delete of a slot no longer
  live". N-49's own evidence is the `tombstone` op: a freed record that sits in a static partition after a
  `rebuildPartitions` / stage-end rebuild.
* *Mutant X07.* In `lawfulCoarserFaceWrite`, `(w.op === 'tombstone' || w.op === 'delete')` becomes `(w.op === 'delete')`.
  * Near set: the invariants folder (4 files), `test/tx` (13 files) and `insert/step3-5/lifecycle.test.ts`, at full
    strength. Result: `Tests 311 passed (311)`, so X07 SURVIVED.
  * Related at 1000 on `invariants/batch.ts` in the mirror: `Tests 3 failed | 2597 passed (2600)`. The 3 failures are
    `site/test/terrain/range.test.ts` and `arr-booleans-buffers` `harness` / `register`, the same in-flight reds as on
    the fix. So X07 SURVIVED.
  * `runner/constructive.test.ts` and `bench/test/fuzz-bar/entry.test.ts` pass under X07. The reason is that the stale
    `CONSTRUCTIVE_KNOWN` rows (N-49's follow-on, not yet dropped) expect exactly this refusal.
* *Why it is not equivalent.* Under X07 the constructive judge gives `index/slot-reuse-stage: 0/8 green` and
  `index/slot-reuse-districts: 0/8 green`, with the same 'tombstone of face 0' refusals as the pre-fix code. These are
  honest inputs: insert, stage-end rebuild, then remove, which is the regeneration path. CONFIRMED.
* *Why the item's tests miss it.* The N-13 round trips never rebuild partitions between the insert and the removal. The
  freed own children are therefore dynamic grid entries and are written as `delete` only. The assertion
  `expect(['tombstone', 'delete']).toContain(w.op)` holds without a single tombstone. The C-0235 test column's
  "tombstones / deletes at L1 (and L2)" describes what is allowed, not what is exercised.
* *Checker control that kills X07* (`zz-control-s1.test.ts`, mirror only). This is N-13's example, L3 and L2. The steps
  are: insert through `suiteTx`, then `rebuildAtStageEnd(p)`, then `removeEdges` through `suiteTx`. The control expects
  ok, `allProblems` empty, the print restored, at least one coarser `tombstone` in the log, and every coarser write's
  slot not live.
  * On the fix: `Tests 2 passed (2)`.
  * Under X07: `Tests 2 failed (2)` with `E_INVARIANT index-freshness: an L3 batch wrote the L1 index (tombstone of face 0 (L1)) outside its promotions and demotions`.
  * CONFIRMED.
* **Required change (test only, no source change).** Add the control above to `kernel/test/invariants/fixtures.test.ts`
  in the N-49 describe. It needs the L3 and L2 variants, a partition rebuild (`rebuildAtStageEnd`) between the insert
  and the removal, and an assertion that the coarser log holds a `tombstone` of a non-live slot. Then re-run the near
  set and kill X07.
